# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/subscription

Watch a repo (subscribe to notifications)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-197`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — WatchInfo

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `subscribed` | bool | Whether the repository is being watched |
| `ignored` | bool | Whether notifications are ignored |
| `reason` | any | Reason for watch status |
| `created_at` | time.Time | When the watch was created |
| `url` | string | URL for managing watch status |
| `repository_url` | string | URL of the repository |

- **403** — User is blocked by repo owner
- **404** — Repo does not exist

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User cannot watch a repo if they are blocked by the repo owner | authorization | user_model.IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, doer, repo.OwnerID) |
| Auto-watch mode is not overridden if user already has explicit watch or dont-watch | state_transition | mode == WatchModeAuto && (watch.Mode == WatchModeDont || IsWatchMode(watch.Mode)) |
| Repository num_watches counter is updated when watch mode transitions between watchable and non-watchable states | business_logic | IsWatchMode(mode) != IsWatchMode(watch.Mode) |
